final_assessment: docs-under-test explored to a proposable shape (Sal ratified each decision). Seven decisions: D-dut-1 the residue check admits the old name in four places; D-dut-2 a pending-rewrite file list exact both ways; D-dut-3 interim states need no protection (the program runs atomically and is validated by use); D-dut-4 each surface judged against its own declared-heads fence; D-dut-5 a new orbit-user-docs capability owns the docs checks while orbit-cli-grammar widens three domains; D-dut-6 one-line commands; D-dut-7 non-vacuity floors over unlisted files, active once the list empties. Five rules, all with Mechanism entries; D-dut-1 BOUNDED. No open questions.

residuals.kind: an upstream name or link form that contains none of `openspec`, `opsx` or `fission` (a renamed product, a shortened URL, a logo asset path)
residuals.method: a case-insensitive grep of upstream's v1.3.1 README and docs (the `upstream/v1.3.1` tag) for its product, org and link names, compared against the three patterns, plus the public-readiness stage's sweep of upstream assets and links
